content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a minor adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause, payment for the second installment is deferred for ninety days, which delays receipt of revenue. I propose that the second installment of $115,250.00 shall be paid within thirty (30) days from the Effective Date of this Agreement. Thank you for your flexibility.
